metadata.name: fsck
metadata.displayName: fsck - Check and repair a Linux filesystem
metadata.description: Check and repair a Linux filesystem

installation.note: fsck is a front-end; fsck.ext4, fsck.xfs, etc. are in e2fsprogs, xfsprogs

overview.summary: fsck (filesystem check) checks and optionally repairs a filesystem. The filesystem should be unmounted (or read-only). fsck is a front-end: fsck.ext4 runs e2fsck, etc. Run after unclean shutdown or when errors are suspected.
when_to_use: Check filesystem after crash or unclean shutdown

syntax.description: DEVICE is the partition (e.g., /dev/sdb1). Unmount first (or use from recovery). TYPE can be ext4, etc.

options.description: Assume yes to all prompts (non-interactive repair)
Force check even if filesystem looks clean (e2fsck)
Assume no; do not make changes (check only)

examples.title: Check and repair (unmount first)
examples.description: Unmount then run fsck with auto yes

common_pitfalls.description: Running fsck on a mounted filesystem can cause corruption.
common_pitfalls.solution: Unmount the filesystem first (umount), or run from recovery/live media.
